text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, organized essay with introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"Controls overall structure more effectively, with ideas grouped into clear paragraphs and a recognizable introduction and conclusion."},{"evidence":"multiple developed examples about a friend, the writer, and a teacher","quality":"idea development","description":"Expands claims with more relevant supporting detail rather than relying on a single brief personal example."},{"evidence":"linking phrases like \"For that reasons,\" \"After he start,\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"Uses more transitions and textual signals to connect ideas across and within paragraphs."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"It helps me to forget all the problems that cause me stress\" and \"They were kind with me\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"Shows somewhat better control of sentence construction, with fewer severely broken or fragmentary sentences."},{"evidence":"wording like \"benefit in their future,\" \"sociable,\" and \"creative part\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"Uses a broader range of more formal, topic-appropriate vocabulary to discuss the issue."},{"evidence":"comparatives and cause-effect phrases throughout, such as \"that cause more stress on him\" and \"helps to have a good future\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"Explains reasons and effects more fully, giving the writing more depth than simple repetition of the main idea."}]}
